accordion.definingConstraint: Expands and collapses vertical disclosure panels smoothly via CSS height transitions under Base UI ARIA keyboard controls.
whenToUse: FAQs, collapsible inspector subsections, or compact mobile configuration groups.
Progressive disclosure blocks allowing multiple peer panels open simultaneously.

whenNotToUse.reason: Use Tabs when switching horizontally across parallel content views.

accordion.anatomy:
<Accordion defaultValue={["item-1"]}>
  <AccordionItem value="item-1">
    <AccordionTrigger>Quiet Chrome</AccordionTrigger>
    <AccordionContent>Typography and whitespace replace card noise.</AccordionContent>
  </AccordionItem>
</Accordion>

alert-dialog.definingConstraint: Forces explicit user acknowledgement via high-friction modal focus trapping that blocks accidental backdrop dismissal.
whenToUse: Irreversible destructive operations such as deleting repositories, revoking production API keys, or discarding unsaved work.
High-consequence billing or security actions requiring explicit Cancel vs Confirm choice.

whenNotToUse.reason: Use Dialog for general forms or inspectable modals where outside-click dismissal is safe.
Use Toast with an undo button for recoverable actions.

alert-dialog.anatomy:
<AlertDialog>
  <AlertDialogTrigger className={buttonVariants({ variant: "destructive" })}>Revoke Key</AlertDialogTrigger>
  <AlertDialogContent>
    <AlertDialogHeader>
      <AlertDialogTitle>Revoke key?</AlertDialogTitle>
      <AlertDialogDescription>Traffic using this token stops immediately.</AlertDialogDescription>
    </AlertDialogHeader>
    <AlertDialogFooter>
      <AlertDialogCancel>Cancel</AlertDialogCancel>
      <AlertDialogAction>Revoke Key</AlertDialogAction>
    </AlertDialogFooter>
  </AlertDialogContent>
</AlertDialog>

avatar.definingConstraint: Deterministically computes harmonious OKLCH fallback colours from initials while cleanly supporting presence pips and overlapping AvatarGroup stacks.
whenToUse: Team member identity badges, commit actor nodes, comment headers, and presence bars.
Compact collaborator groups with deterministic fallback monograms.

whenNotToUse.reason: Use Badge for short system status pills rather than user identity.
Use ProgressiveImage for rectangular content imagery and hero frames.

badge.definingConstraint: Locks shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap operational pills with tabular numerals and optional resting-plateau pulse indicators; banned above titles as decorative eyebrow kickers.
whenToUse: Operational telemetry (`healthy`, `degraded`, version numbers, active counts, or Required form flags).
Inline metadata tags pinned cleanly beside card titles or table row states.

whenNotToUse.reason: Use Callout for multi-line rules or section notices rather than oversized pills.
Use Button or Toggle when clicking triggers an action.

breadcrumb.definingConstraint: Clarifies hierarchy levels cleanly without overflowing horizontal bars, marking the final destination with aria-current="page" instead of a link.
whenToUse: Deep nested views, component reference pages, or file hierarchy detail screens.
Orienting users two or more levels below top-level navigation.

whenNotToUse.reason: Use NavigationBar for global site-wide primary route links.
Use Tabs for switching between peer panels at the same hierarchy level.

button.definingConstraint: Locks horizontal button footprint with an invisible ghost sizer across idle, loading, success, and error states while compressing immediately on pointerdown.
whenToUse: Triggering immediate actions, form submissions, or asynchronous mutations with Promise lifecycle feedback.
Presenting primary, secondary, destructive, outline, ghost, or warning actions with proportional icon affinity.

whenNotToUse.reason: Use Toggle for persistent two-state pressed controls.
Use CopyButton for one-click clipboard copy with morphing checkmark timing.
Use SegmentedControl when switching between 2 to 5 mutually exclusive views.

calendar.definingConstraint: Renders keyboard-navigable month grids with spring horizontal slide transitions and tabular-nums date cells, pairing directly with DatePicker popovers.
whenToUse: Scheduling views, release windows, filter date selection, and inline month calendars.
Forms requiring visual day-of-week awareness via Calendar or DatePicker.

whenNotToUse.reason: Use Input for memorable dates like birth years where typing is faster than stepping backward by month.

callout.definingConstraint: Highlights non-negotiable architectural constraints, semantic tips, or operational warnings in OKLCH-tinted blocks without decorative eyebrow pill clutter.
whenToUse: Calling out defining constraints, breaking invariant rules, tips, or caution notices inside guides.
Surfacing high-signal validation reminders directly alongside runnable code examples.

whenNotToUse.reason: Use Badge for short single-value operational telemetry pills.
Use Toast for transient post-action notifications.

callout.anatomy:
<Callout variant="defining-constraint" title="Zero Layout Shift">
  Reserve border width on resting states.
</Callout>

card.definingConstraint: Enforces mathematical concentric corner continuity via CardInner inside Card alongside subtle 1px specular rim lighting; avoid defaulting every layout to 3-card grids.
whenToUse: Bounded workspace modules, detail inspectors, or distinct nested settings panels.
Bento showcase items pairing CardHeader chrome with concentric CardInner nesting.

whenNotToUse.reason: Use Table or ruled divide-y lists when presenting repetitive comparable entities.
Use Callout for semantic notices, warnings, and constraints.

chart.definingConstraint: Renders zero-dependency perceptual OKLCH SVG Sparklines, AreaCharts, and BarCharts scaled crisply with tabular metric axes.
whenToUse: Latency sparklines, throughput trendlines, contrast bounds, and daily activity bars.
Telemetry panels needing lightweight OKLCH SVGs without external chart library overhead.

whenNotToUse.reason: Use Table when readers must look up and sort exact raw rows.
Use DiagramFrame for architecture flowcharts rather than quantitative charts.

checkbox.definingConstraint: Expands hit area with an invisible 44px touch target around a crisp rounded indicator supporting checked, unchecked, and indeterminate states.
whenToUse: Multi-select option lists, table row selection, or opt-in policy acknowledgements inside forms.
Parent-child selection trees requiring an indeterminate mixed state.

whenNotToUse.reason: Use Switch for immediate system settings that take effect without a Save button.
Use RadioGroup when only one option from a small list can be selected.

code-block.definingConstraint: Frames concentric code viewports (`rounded-2xl` outer, `rounded-[10px]` inner) with tabular-nums line gutters, focus line highlights, SegmentedControl tabs, and CopyButton.
whenToUse: Presenting verified source snippets, CLI command tabs (Install / Verify), and highlighted config blocks.
Side-by-side multi-framework installation tabs powered by SegmentedControl.

whenNotToUse.reason: Use ComponentPreview when pairing runnable interactive output alongside its TSX code.
Use Kbd for inline physical keycaps.

code-block.anatomy:
<CodeBlock filename="verify.sh" language="bash" highlightLines={[2]} code="npm run docs:build
npm run check" />

combobox.definingConstraint: Pairs a filterable text input with a headless Base UI listbox popup supporting keyboard type-ahead and empty state feedback.
whenToUse: Choosing one or more options from large sets (more than 10 items) where users type to filter.
Country pickers, model selectors, or filterable tag selectors.

whenNotToUse.reason: Use Select when there are 5 to 12 familiar options that do not need text filtering.
Use Command for global modal application command palettes (⌘K).

combobox.anatomy:
<Combobox items={frameworks} value={value} onValueChange={setValue}>
  <ComboboxInput aria-label="Select framework" placeholder="Search..." />
  <ComboboxContent>
    <ComboboxList>
      <ComboboxItem value="React">React</ComboboxItem>
      <ComboboxEmpty>No matches found.</ComboboxEmpty>
    </ComboboxList>
  </ComboboxContent>
</Combobox>

command.definingConstraint: Indexes searchable keyboard actions inside either an inline panel or a global focus-trapped CommandDialog (⌘K) with tabular keycap hints.
whenToUse: Application-wide ⌘K command palettes, quick navigation jumps, and action search.
Filtering structured commands grouped under headings with keyboard arrows.

whenNotToUse.reason: Use Combobox when binding a selected option value inside a form field.
Use Select for compact fixed option lists without global actions.

command.anatomy:
<Command aria-label="Quick actions">
  <CommandInput placeholder="Search commands..." />
  <CommandList>
    <CommandEmpty>No matching commands.</CommandEmpty>
    <CommandGroup heading="Navigation">
      <CommandItem>Open Docs<CommandShortcut>⌘D</CommandShortcut></CommandItem>
    </CommandGroup>
  </CommandList>
</Command>

component-preview.definingConstraint: Provides a symmetric centred stage (`min-h-[180px]`) with live Preview/Code toggling, `375px`/`768px`/`100%` viewport presets, and stateful component reset.
whenToUse: Documenting interactive primitives with live runnable fixtures backed by verified source code.
Verifying component anti-crush responsiveness live across 375px, 768px, and 100% widths.

whenNotToUse.reason: Use CodeBlock for pure CLI commands, CSS tokens, or TypeScript configuration snippets.
Use DiagramFrame for vector SVG architecture schematics.

context-menu.definingConstraint: Attaches a secondary pointer contextmenu surface with keyboard arrow traversal, checkboxes, radio groups, and submenu support.
whenToUse: Desktop canvas nodes, file trees, or table rows needing contextual right-click power actions.
Compact secondary command lists preserving screen space across dense workbenches.

whenNotToUse.reason: Use DropdownMenu when actions must also be discoverable via a visible button.
Use Popover for structured forms or rich non-menu widgets.

copy-button.definingConstraint: Encapsulates clipboard write handling and spring morph transitions between idle copy and temporary confirmation states without shifting adjacent controls.
whenToUse: Copying CLI commands, API keys, token values, or generated code blocks to the clipboard.
Inline copy triggers inside tables, headers, and developer toolbars.

whenNotToUse.reason: Use Button for general actions or mutations.
Use Toggle for persistent boolean state switches.

copy-button.anatomy: <CopyButton value="npm run check" idleText="Copy" copiedText="Copied" variant="outline" size="sm" />

diagram-frame.definingConstraint: Encapsulates accessible SVG diagrams inside semantic `<figure>` and `<figcaption>` landmarks with horizontal scroll safety and a focus-trapped expanded zoom Dialog.
whenToUse: State machines, data-flow pipelines, component hierarchies, and token pipelines drawn as orthogonal SVGs.
Architecture explanations needing accessible `<figcaption>` semantics and full-width modal expansion.

whenNotToUse.reason: Use ProgressiveImage for photographic raster assets.
Use ComponentPreview for interactive UI widgets.

diagram-frame.anatomy:
<DiagramFrame title="Pipeline Schematic" description="Connects blueprint to verified output.">
  <svg aria-label="Pipeline schematic">...</svg>
</DiagramFrame>

dialog.definingConstraint: Renders a focus-trapped liquid backdrop modal dialogue with Apple spring scaling and reliable Escape/backdrop dismissal.
whenToUse: Focused secondary forms, inspector modals, or expanded media/diagram inspection.
Multi-field edits needing temporary focus isolation without navigating away from context.

whenNotToUse.reason: Use AlertDialog when outside-click dismissal must be blocked for destructive confirmation.
Use Sheet for wide filter panels, settings drawers, or side-by-side detail editors.
Use Drawer for swipeable compact mobile bottom sheets.

dialog.anatomy:
<Dialog>
  <DialogTrigger className={buttonVariants({ variant: "outline" })}>Edit Spec</DialogTrigger>
  <DialogContent>
    <DialogHeader>
      <DialogTitle>Edit Token Preset</DialogTitle>
      <DialogDescription>Adjust base hue and contrast thresholds.</DialogDescription>
    </DialogHeader>
    <DialogFooter><DialogClose>Done</DialogClose></DialogFooter>
  </DialogContent>
</Dialog>

doc-layout.definingConstraint: Enforces a 1440px-capped three-column editorial reading layout with zero-shift sidebar active styling, 72ch article measure, Copy Page as Markdown action, and verification TOC.
whenToUse: Product documentation portals, API reference guides, and internal engineering handbooks.
Technical manuals combining navigable group sidebars with copyable Markdown exports.

whenNotToUse.reason: Use NavigationBar for global top-level application headers above DocLayout.

doc-layout.anatomy:
<DocLayout>
  <DocSidebar groups={groups} activeId={id} onSelect={setId} />
  <DocArticle markdownSource={md}>
    <section>...</section>
  </DocArticle>
  <DocToc headings={headings} verificationChecks={checks} />
</DocLayout>

drawer.definingConstraint: Provides a swipeable edge drawer with tactile drag handle chrome tailored to thumb-reach compact viewports.
whenToUse: Mobile action sheets, compact filters, or contextual forms originating from the bottom viewport edge.
Touch-first pickers where drag-down gesture dismissal feels natural.

whenNotToUse.reason: Use Sheet for persistent left or right desktop slide-over panels.
Use Dialog for centred desktop modal tasks.

drawer.anatomy:
<Drawer>
  <DrawerTrigger className={buttonVariants({ variant: "outline" })}>Open Drawer</DrawerTrigger>
  <DrawerContent>
    <DrawerHandle />
    <DrawerHeader>
      <DrawerTitle>Filter Results</DrawerTitle>
      <DrawerDescription>Narrow dataset by severity.</DrawerDescription>
    </DrawerHeader>
  </DrawerContent>
</Drawer>

dropdown-menu.definingConstraint: Preserves zero-jitter anchor alignment by keeping trigger buttons unscaled while presenting liquid glass action, checkbox, and radio menus.
whenToUse: Compact overflow "More" menus, row action buttons, or profile menu actions.
Hierarchical action lists supporting toggleable checkboxes and radio view modes.

whenNotToUse.reason: Use Select when picking a value stored in form state.
Use Popover when rendering interactive inputs, sliders, or custom panels.

field.definingConstraint: Connects accessible label, input control, helper description, and min-h-[1lh] error slots under shared Base UI invalid state IDs.
whenToUse: Every form control requiring a visible label, validation message, or supporting hint.
Preventing vertical page jumps when error states toggle between valid and invalid.

whenNotToUse.reason: Use Callout for page-level banners rather than per-input validation.

field.anatomy:
<Field invalid={Boolean(error)}>
  <FieldLabel requiredIndicator>Workspace Slug</FieldLabel>
  <Input value={slug} onChange={...} />
  <FieldDescription>Lowercase URL identifier.</FieldDescription>
  <FieldError match={Boolean(error)}>{error}</FieldError>
</Field>

file-upload.definingConstraint: Validates accepted MIME types and maximum byte size client-side inside an accessible drag-and-drop region backed by a visually hidden file input.
whenToUse: Uploading JSON token themes, CSV datasets, images, or PDF reports with client validation.
Accepting dropped assets alongside explicit file dialogue fallback buttons.

whenNotToUse.reason: Use standard Input for short text strings or URLs.

file-upload.anatomy: <FileUpload title="Drop token preset" description="JSON files up to 5MB" accept=".json" onFilesSelected={handleFiles} />

hover-card.definingConstraint: Displays passive, non-essential supplementary reference details on pointer hover or link focus with gentle timing hysteresis.
whenToUse: User profile cards, git commit previews, or token definitions hovering over inline anchors.
Read-only reference summaries enrichment over navigation links.

whenNotToUse.reason: Use Tooltip for short plain-text key hints or icon button labels.
Use Popover whenever content needs reliable click-open persistence on touch screens.

image.definingConstraint: Eliminates cumulative layout shift by locking aspectRatio geometry upfront and cross-fading smoothly once decoded.
whenToUse: Editorial photography, product screenshots, and media thumbnails inside cards or hero banners.
Aspect-locked media panels guaranteeing zero layout shift during async image decoding.

whenNotToUse.reason: Use Avatar for circular user or organisation portraits.
Use DiagramFrame for interactive vector SVGs.

input.definingConstraint: Maintains a minimum 16px base font size on mobile viewports (<640px) to stop iOS Safari auto-zoom while hugging focus rings cleanly at 1px.
whenToUse: Single-line text, email, search, API key, or numeric form entry.
Search fields enhanced with leftIcon, rightIcon, prefixText, or suffixText add-ons.

whenNotToUse.reason: Use Textarea for multi-line prose, notes, or JSON payloads.
Use InputOTP for fixed-length SMS or authenticator verification codes.
Use Stepper when users increment small integer counters step by step.

input-otp.definingConstraint: Renders visual individual PIN character boxes over a single hidden accessible text input supporting one-paste autofill across all slots.
whenToUse: Two-factor authenticator codes, email verification PINs, or SMS 6-digit passcodes.
Structured fixed-length token verification flows supporting clipboard auto-fill.

whenNotToUse.reason: Use standard Input for freeform passwords, usernames, or promo codes.

input-otp.anatomy:
<InputOTP maxLength={6} aria-label="Verification code">
  <InputOTPGroup>
    <InputOTPSlot index={0} />
    <InputOTPSlot index={1} />
    <InputOTPSlot index={2} />
  </InputOTPGroup>
  <InputOTPSeparator />
  <InputOTPGroup>
    <InputOTPSlot index={3} />
    <InputOTPSlot index={4} />
    <InputOTPSlot index={5} />
  </InputOTPGroup>
</InputOTP>

kbd.definingConstraint: Styles tactile hardware keycap hints with uniform baseline height and tabular monospace glyph spacing.
whenToUse: Documenting global keyboard shortcuts (`⌘K`, `⌘D`, `Escape`) inside buttons, menus, and docs.
Communicating hotkeys alongside CommandPalette or NavigationBar triggers.

whenNotToUse.reason: Use Badge for runtime status pills such as Active or v2.0.
Use Button for clickable actions; Kbd is strictly non-interactive notation.

markdown-toolbar.definingConstraint: Coordinates rich Markdown insertion, line-prefix toggling, and table scaffolding while sanitising heading levels against existing line structures.
whenToUse: Paired above a Markdown Textarea for technical notes, issue composers, or changelog editors.
When writers need keyboard-accessible heading, list, quote, link, and table formatting actions.

whenNotToUse.reason: Use generic Toolbar for non-Markdown canvas tools or custom app button rows.
Use ToggleGroup for a small set of inline formatting flags.

navigation-bar.definingConstraint: Prevents header text truncation and crowding using container queries, minimum 220px submenu columns, explicit popover width bases, and automatic overflow harvesting.
whenToUse: Global top application headers combining branding, mega-menu flyouts, direct route links, and utility actions.
Responsive headers transitioning smoothly to a Sheet navigation drawer on narrow mobile screens.

whenNotToUse.reason: Use Toolbar for scoped editor or canvas tool buttons.
Use DocSidebar inside DocLayout for multi-section vertical documentation trees.

navigation-bar.anatomy: Design System} items={navItems} maxVisibleItems={4} actions={} />

number-ticker.definingConstraint: Interpolates numeric changes via calibrated spring deceleration while enforcing font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so column digits never vibrate.
whenToUse: Live KPI telemetry counters, build pass totals, contrast score indicators, and odometer readouts.
Tabular metric cards or Stepper value displays requiring smooth spring transitions.

whenNotToUse.reason: Use Stepper when users actively increment or decrement a numeric input.
Use Progress when visualising completion towards a 100% bound.

pagination.definingConstraint: Formats numeric page counters with tabular-nums and frames active pages via colour contrast rather than weight shifts so buttons never jitter across pages.
whenToUse: Stepping through server-backed or large client collections split into deterministic pages.
Icon galleries, audit log tables, and search result sets.

whenNotToUse.reason: Use Tabs when switching between named categorical views rather than sequential pages.
Use Stepper for selecting numeric input quantities in forms.

popover.definingConstraint: Anchors non-modal interactive overlays with automatic viewport collision avoidance while letting outside clicks dismiss naturally.
whenToUse: Date pickers, inline filter panels, share dialogues, or compact configuration forms.
Trigger-anchored interactive mini-panels that keep surrounding context visible.

whenNotToUse.reason: Use Tooltip for static single-line micro-hints without interactive widgets.
Use DropdownMenu for uniform lists of commands.
Use Dialog when background interaction should be blocked modally.

progress.definingConstraint: Translates percentage progress linearly or radially using compositor transforms rather than width reflows across smooth spring updates.
whenToUse: File uploads, build pipeline stages, and bounded completion indicators (`0` to `100`).
Compact radial completion indicators using CircularProgress beside status labels.

whenNotToUse.reason: Use Skeleton when awaiting unknown layout content instead of tracking percentage progress.
Use Slider for user-controllable value selection.

prop-table.definingConstraint: Renders anti-crush TypeScript prop specifications inside a responsive Table using shrink-0 Required badges and tabular default indicators.
whenToUse: Documenting exported TypeScript *Props interfaces extracted by AST or authored manually.
Comparing prop names, union type strings, default values, and Required flags cleanly.

whenNotToUse.reason: Use Table directly for operational datasets, metrics, or cluster ledgers.

prop-table.anatomy: <PropTable title="ButtonProps" props={[{ name: "variant", type: '"default" | "outline"', defaultValue: '"default"', description: "Selects visual button role." }]} />

radio-group.definingConstraint: Enforces single-choice mutual exclusion across visible options with arrow-key roving focus and a smooth spring indicator dot.
whenToUse: Comparing 2 to 5 mutually exclusive choices where seeing all option descriptions side by side helps.
Billing tier selection, export formats, or deployment regions inside forms.

whenNotToUse.reason: Use Select when more than 5 options would clutter the layout.
Use SegmentedControl for immediate UI view switching outside form submission.

resizable.definingConstraint: Coordinates keyboard-adjustable (Arrow keys) and pointer-draggable split panes with percentage persistence inside zero-scroll layout boundaries.
whenToUse: Side-by-side code and preview editors, log inspectors, and configurable split studios.
Desktop engineering workbenches where users adjust panel proportions interactively.

whenNotToUse.reason: Use DocLayout for structured fixed-measure reading documentation columns.

resizable.anatomy:
<ResizablePanelGroup direction="horizontal" defaultSizes={[45, 55]}>
  <ResizablePanel order={0} defaultSize={45}>Controls</ResizablePanel>
  <ResizableHandle handleIndex={0} withHandle />
  <ResizablePanel order={1} defaultSize={55}>Stage</ResizablePanel>
</ResizablePanelGroup>

scroll-area.definingConstraint: Provides uniform minimal custom scrollbars without disturbing content gutter symmetry across macOS, Windows, and Linux browsers.
whenToUse: Bounded lists, command drawers, preview trees, and sticky sidebar navigation panels.
Compact scrollable regions preserving visual scrollbar styling across browsers.

whenNotToUse.reason: Let top-level document prose scroll naturally with the main browser viewport.

scroll-area.anatomy: ...

segmented-control.definingConstraint: Animates a single shared spring background pill across mutually exclusive tabs while keeping text weight frozen so labels never twitch horizontally.
whenToUse: Switching immediately between 2 to 5 compact modes such as Preview/Code, Light/Dark, or billing cadence.
High-frequency view filters where all options remain visible at once.

whenNotToUse.reason: Use Tabs when switching full content panels with keyboard arrow activation.
Use RadioGroup inside forms when choices submit with form data.
Use Select when there are more than 5 options.

select.definingConstraint: Built on headless Base UI Select primitives with liquid glass overlay elevation and keyboard type-ahead selection without native browser inconsistencies.
whenToUse: Selecting one fixed value from 5 to 15 compact choices inside forms or toolbars.
Choosing environment targets, locales, or categorical form fields without text search.

whenNotToUse.reason: Use Combobox when users need live text filtering over long option lists.
Use RadioGroup when 2 to 4 choices benefit from being visible upfront.
Use DropdownMenu for triggering commands rather than picking a form value.

select.anatomy:
<Select value={region} onValueChange={setRegion}>
  <SelectTrigger aria-label="Deployment region">
    <SelectValue placeholder="Choose region" />
  </SelectTrigger>
  <SelectContent>
    <SelectItem value="lon">London (eu-west-2)</SelectItem>
  </SelectContent>
</Select>

sheet.definingConstraint: Slides an edge-docked panel (top, right, bottom, or left) over the viewport while trapping focus and keeping liquid backdrop blur coherent.
whenToUse: Theme Studios, audit inspectors, notification feeds, or responsive mobile navigation drawers.
Detail views requiring full viewport height alongside scrollable bodies and pinned footers.

whenNotToUse.reason: Use Dialog for compact centred confirmation or creation forms.
Use Drawer specifically for swipe-gestured bottom sheets on touch devices.

sheet.anatomy:
<Sheet>
  <SheetTrigger className={buttonVariants({ variant: "outline" })}>Inspect Logs</SheetTrigger>
  <SheetContent side="right">
    <SheetHeader>
      <SheetTitle>Cluster Telemetry</SheetTitle>
      <SheetDescription>Live event stream across edge regions.</SheetDescription>
    </SheetHeader>
  </SheetContent>
</Sheet>

skeleton.definingConstraint: Mirrors the exact target component geometry before hydration or async data resolves to maintain zero Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS).
whenToUse: Initial loading states matching exact card, text row, or avatar proportions.
Async route transitions needing zero-CLS placeholders until streamed data arrives.

whenNotToUse.reason: Use Progress when exact completion percentage of a known operation can be reported.

slider.definingConstraint: Locks track height while gliding single or dual thumbs along direct pointer scrub gestures with tabular numeric value readouts.
whenToUse: Adjusting continuous numeric coordinates such as OKLCH lightness, chroma, opacity, or min/max price ranges.
Interactive visual inspection controls where live preview feedback responds immediately.

whenNotToUse.reason: Use Stepper when users increment discrete integer quantities accurately by +1/-1.
Use Input when exact typed digits matter more than visual scrub speed.

slider.anatomy: <Slider aria-label="Chroma intensity" value={chroma} onValueChange={setChroma} min={0} max={100} />

stepper.definingConstraint: Combines hold-to-accelerate increment/decrement repeat buttons with a tabular sliding NumberTicker readout so multi-digit transitions never shift layout.
whenToUse: Adjusting discrete counts such as seat count, retry attempts, or replica counts.
Spin-button numeric inputs benefiting from hold-to-accelerate progression.

whenNotToUse.reason: Use Slider for fast continuous percentage or coordinate tuning.
Use Input when users type arbitrary numbers such as ports or prices.

stepper.anatomy:
<Stepper value={replicas} onValueChange={setReplicas} min={1} max={16}>
  <Stepper.Decrement aria-label="Decrease replicas" />
  <Stepper.Value />
  <Stepper.Increment aria-label="Increase replicas" />
</Stepper>

switch.definingConstraint: Pairs an instant spring thumb travel inside a 44px accessible touch target with subtle active pill elongation on pointerdown.
whenToUse: Immediate on/off settings toggles that apply live without submitting a form.
Preference rows pairing concise labels with binary system feature flags.

whenNotToUse.reason: Use Checkbox inside forms that commit only on submit or in multi-select lists.
Use Toggle inside compact icon toolbars.

table.definingConstraint: Pairs quiet hairline row dividers and subtle sticky headers with numeric={true} right-aligned tabular-nums cells so dense columns align accurately.
whenToUse: Comparable multi-column datasets, token ledgers, telemetry metrics, and API audit trails.
Structured rows combining tabular-nums metrics with aligned status badges.

whenNotToUse.reason: Use PropTable when documenting component TypeScript props specifically.
Use Timeline for narrative chronological event streams.

tabs.definingConstraint: Glides a spring-physics layout indicator across full-panel navigation triggers while locking label font weight across inactive and active states.
whenToUse: Switching between distinct multi-control panels (Account, Billing, Telemetry) at the same hierarchy level.
Organising complex configuration studios without forcing full page navigation.

whenNotToUse.reason: Use SegmentedControl for compact inline pills or viewport/mode toggles.
Use Accordion when users benefit from expanding multiple vertical sections concurrently.

textarea.definingConstraint: Preserves flush 1px border-hugging focus contrast and mobile 16px zoom protection across arbitrary multi-line prose heights.
whenToUse: Comments, system prompts, multi-line release notes, or structured descriptions.
Markdown authoring areas paired directly beneath MarkdownToolbar.

whenNotToUse.reason: Use Input for single-line values such as titles or email addresses.

theme-toggle.definingConstraint: Switches document light and dark colour classes while temporarily disabling CSS transitions so sibling surfaces do not smear across themes.
whenToUse: Top navigation bars, settings headers, or workbench rails offering instant polarity switching.
Restoring persistent dark or light class selection synchronised across sessions.

whenNotToUse.reason: Use Switch for generic boolean preferences inside forms.
Use SegmentedControl when exposing three modes such as Light, Dark, and System.

timeline.definingConstraint: Connects chronological milestones using compositor-pure pulse nodes and continuous vertical connector stems with zero paint-filter repaints.
whenToUse: Deployment pipelines, git commit histories, audit logs, and workflow execution traces.
Ordered milestone feeds mixing avatar actors, commit hashes, and live status nodes.

whenNotToUse.reason: Use Table when comparing flat tabular fields across many uniform records.
Use Accordion for static Q&A disclosure sections.

toast.definingConstraint: Delivers non-blocking status feedback anchored outside flow layout with an optional 5-second reversible undo trigger via ToastProvider and useToast.
whenToUse: Confirming background saves, exports, copies, or reversible item removals.
Surfacing asynchronous deployment completion without interrupting active typing.

whenNotToUse.reason: Use AlertDialog before irreversible actions rather than apologising in a Toast afterwards.
Use Callout for persistent inline page guidance or validation rules.

toggle.definingConstraint: Maintains identical perimeter geometry across pressed and unpressed states using background surface contrast and aria-pressed semantics.
whenToUse: Independent two-state toolbar buttons such as Bold, Italic, Pin, or Mute.
Immediate active/inactive mode switches without form submit steps.

whenNotToUse.reason: Use Switch when labelling a settings option row with on/off meaning.
Use Button for one-shot commands rather than stateful latching controls.

toggle.anatomy:
<Toggle pressed={muted} onPressedChange={setMuted} variant="outline" aria-label="Mute alerts">
  Muted
</Toggle>

toggle-group.definingConstraint: Distributes shared variant and size context plus roving arrow-key navigation across a related set of Toggle buttons.
whenToUse: Grouping 2 to 5 compact formatting or alignment options (left, centre, right).
Allowing either single or multiple simultaneous active toggle flags in a compact bar.

whenNotToUse.reason: Use SegmentedControl for sliding pill single-view switchers.
Use RadioGroup inside labelled forms.

toggle-group.anatomy:
<ToggleGroup value={align} onValueChange={setAlign} variant="surface">
  <Toggle value="left" aria-label="Align left" />
  <Toggle value="center" aria-label="Align centre" />
</ToggleGroup>

toolbar.definingConstraint: Unifies multiple button groups, links, and toggle clusters into a single composite ARIA toolbar with single-tab-stop arrow navigation.
whenToUse: Desktop canvas action rails combining standalone action buttons, separators, and inline toggles.
Editor headers grouping related formatting and alignment controls.

whenNotToUse.reason: Use MarkdownToolbar specifically when editing Markdown strings.
Use NavigationBar for global site route headers and flyout menus.

tooltip.definingConstraint: Presents micro plain-text clarifications on icon buttons and keyboard shortcuts within a shared TooltipProvider warmup window.
whenToUse: Explaining icon-only controls, displaying keyboard shortcuts (`⌘K`), or clarifying truncated telemetry codes.
Lightweight micro-hints on hover or keyboard focus without adding visible chrome.

whenNotToUse.reason: Use Popover if the overlay contains clickable links, buttons, or controls.
Use HoverCard for rich multi-line preview panels anchored to links.

tooltip.anatomy:
<TooltipProvider delay={150}>
  <Tooltip>
    <TooltipTrigger aria-label="Show help" className={buttonVariants({ size: "icon-sm", variant: "ghost" })}>?</TooltipTrigger>
    <TooltipContent>Inspect shortcut</TooltipContent>
  </Tooltip>
</TooltipProvider>

tree.definingConstraint: Renders recursive hierarchical file and symbol trees with spring branch expansion, explicit ARIA treeitem levels, and full arrow-key navigation.
whenToUse: File explorers, design token hierarchy browsers, and nested symbol directories.
Expandable directory structures navigable with keyboard arrow keys.

whenNotToUse.reason: Use Accordion for flat one-level disclosure panels.
Use Breadcrumb for linear active path breadcrumbs.
